headline: Market awaits US nonfarm payrolls data; stocks and currency consolidate together, New Taiwan dollar ends two-day gain streak | Industry & Economy
summary: Taiwan stocks and the currency consolidated as investors awaited US nonfarm payrolls data and progress on a US-Iran agreement. The New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.288 per US dollar, down 2.7 points.
why: Taiwan's currency and equity market are sensitive to US labor data and global risk sentiment because of the island's export-heavy economy and large electronics sector.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: The currency ended a two-day gain streak and closed at 32.288 per US dollar.
